skills: Systems and mechanics design, GDDs and one-page specs, rapid prototyping, economy and balance modeling, playtest analysis
Unreal Engine 5 (C++, Blueprint, Chaos, World Partition), Unity (C#, URP), Godot
C++, C#, Blueprint, HLSL, Python, Rust
Perforce, Git, Jira, Visual Studio, Rider, Blender, Nsight Graphics, Excel/VBA

sections.title: Design Lead — Everent (Studio Kismet, FIEA capstone)

intro.D: Momentum-based hoverboard game across an open world of floating sky islands, coming to Steam. Led 7 designers from concept through production; wrote the GDD and one-page specs; ran sprint planning and Jira for the design team.
intro.A: Momentum-based hoverboard game across an open world of floating sky islands in UE5.7 (Nanite, Virtual Shadow Maps, Substrate, World Partition), coming to Steam.
intro.S: Momentum-based hoverboard game across an open world of floating sky islands in UE5.7 (Nanite, Virtual Shadow Maps, World Partition), coming to Steam.

bullets.t: Designed and built velocity-gated destruction system in C++ on Chaos Geometry Collections: two-volume speed detection plus an impact-spawned physics field (strain, directional and radial velocity). It doubles as secret gating and skill expression.

Built an editor tool (Window > Destructibles) that lists every destructible in the level, exposes its tuning and fires a test projectile with in-place reset, so designers tune without entering Play mode.

Implemented a C++ corrupt-surface physical material (world-space gravity, angle-scaled repulsion, boost suppression) as the constraint that keeps puzzles solvable in a game where the player can ride any surface.
Prototyped a compute-shader GPU flocking plugin for ambient sky creatures; when Niagara integration failed, pivoted to instanced meshes driven by CPU readback.
Led the lighting and shadow architecture decision (Lumen vs. baked GI, VSM cost, HLOD) and wrote the team's graphics-settings spec on UGameUserSettings with runtime scalability groups.
Hardened destructibles for World Partition and Data Layer streaming (delegate double-bind fix, overlap resolution at BeginPlay, streaming-safe destroy guards).
Recovered the texture pipeline after a script bypassing the unreal Python API corrupted ~900 texture assets; rolled it back with a Perforce changelist undo.
Authored the GDD and one-page specs for movement, puzzle and progression; integrated DualSense adaptive-trigger haptics tuned per surface.

Built a local playtest analytics pipeline (FFmpeg, faster-whisper, DeepFace, local Llama 3.1) that turns session recordings into transcripts, emotion timelines and coded feedback in the studio's Excel format.

Leading a 10-person team on a co-op game set in the Florida Everglades where players catch invasive animals by hand; hands-on in the build while running scope and leads (art, design, tech, community).

sections.title: Pocket Spaces — stencil portal system (bigger on the inside)

bullets.t: Doorways reveal rooms larger than their exteriors via stencil masking; a player state machine, per-object portal membership and gravity overrides let the player and physics objects cross cleanly.
One-click procedural room builder with a custom inspector (build, rebuild, eject contents, live gravity preview); portal-aware Verlet rope and grapple.
Raymarched hyperbolic Mandelbox volume inside a pocket room with Möbius-transform camera movement; documented stencil depth limits (render queue collapse at depth 3+).
Solo climbing prototype: a reference skeleton drives ConfigurableJoint targets, IK poses arms from wall normals, grip force applies at the wrist; custom ragdoll-builder editor tool.

sections.title: Spatial Engine — ray-traced engine for non-Euclidean spaces

intro.D: Personal engine: architected and directed; implementation AI-assisted.
intro.A: Personal engine, ~145k lines across 13 crates and 600+ commits. I own the architecture, direction and verification; implementation is AI-assisted.
intro.S: Personal engine, ~145k lines and 600+ commits. I own the architecture, direction and verification; implementation is AI-assisted.

bullets.t: Hardware ray-traced Vulkan renderer where spaces with different geometry (hyperbolic, spherical, toroidal) connect through portals, with lighting and shadows traced across them.
Led a measured VR graphics experiment after streamed terrain exposed a radiance-cache bottleneck; extending the distance cascade cut the cache-resolve median from 2.8–5.8 ms to about 0.35 ms.

Lighting stack: ReSTIR direct lighting, one-bounce diffuse GI, SVGF denoising, physically based sky and volumetric atmosphere, DLSS Ray Reconstruction; analytic intersection shaders for curved primitives.
Found and fixed a shader performance regression from GPU timestamp traces by replacing a 64-step sphere tracer with an analytic quadratic solve.
Built benchmark tooling (pinned GPU clocks, power logging) and an OpenXR VR path profiled pass-by-pass in Nsight in the headset.
Integrated into a Godot 4.6 fork as a custom renderer behind a C ABI, so Godot supplies the editor, scripting and asset pipeline.

sections.title: Content Design Mod — Kingdom Come: Deliverance II

bullets.t: Shipped a playable quest mod: scavenger hunt with letter-based delivery, an over-encumbrance mechanic and a twist ending at Trosky Castle, packaged with a scripted build.

A.title: Technical Artist · Real-Time Rendering
A.summary: Technical artist with a rendering-engineer background. I've built a hardware ray-traced Vulkan renderer (ReSTIR, SVGF, DLSS Ray Reconstruction) and shipped UE5 features on a team (compute-shader flocking, lighting architecture, Chaos destruction, editor tools). I profile before I optimize and build tools so artists aren't blocked.
skills: Vulkan ray tracing, ReSTIR, SVGF denoising, ray-traced GI, PBR, volumetrics, compute shaders, raymarching/SDFs, stencil techniques
Unreal Engine 5 (Nanite, Lumen, VSM, Substrate, Niagara, Chaos), Unity URP, Godot (engine fork)
HLSL, GLSL, C++, C#, Rust, Python
Nsight Graphics, Perforce, Git, Blender, Unreal Python, Jira
